content.title: New Debit Cards Have an Unexpected Feature: Rewards
content.summary: Debit cards are getting the credit-card treatment.  This year  Southwest Airlines United Airlines  and  Wyndham Hotels & Resorts  launched debit cards that let customers earn points and miles.  Venmo’s debit card now offers 5% cash back at certain merchants, and Klarna added a premium debit tier that comes with a rose-gold card and access to airport lounges for about $540 a year.

content.title: Citi says a ‘supermajors super-cycle’ is coming for U.S. airlines
content.summary: Investing.com -- Citi analyst John Godyn said in a note Thursday that the U.S. airline industry is heading into what they call a “Supermajors Super-Cycle,” arguing that 2026 will mark the start of an elongated mid-cycle in which the largest network carriers outperform the rest of the sector.

content.title: Delta Air Warns of Profit Hit From Government Shutdown
content.summary: $200 million That's the dent to fourth-quarter profit that Delta Air Lines expects from the U.S. government shutdown.    The carrier said the closure, which spurred regulators to curb air traffic at 40 airports, would dent its earnings by about 25 cents a share this quarter.
